translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Zokit Mau Ea Wane Ŋara Soepine Ma Ne Okanmami, Ea Wane Naŋengo More Rake
Yesu eŋe koso manerop ŋei ŋerep don naŋengo more edane rake,
“Qeli gege togon wakesikei wane, yemo ŋei waom maneŋo gipole zokit mayakane ŋara soep maulukke newanonge, ea wane rokop.
Eŋe qelit medewekoune taleongi ari, ŋei ŋerep newan onge, ea edangoi sari ŋara soep nekeiwane, ŋo eŋe siluŋ sarikei wane mi onge.

Eso eŋe qelit medewekoune natne don iwa yale edane more taleonge, ‘Ŋei ŋerep newanonile eŋe edanbi, “Naŋane ŋara soep mo mauluke mot waremaile, naŋane bulamakau stia so bulamakau medeune kelokine suaine loutne, mo weneŋ engu kitare motmaile, so yeye kine kine korop mo mauluke motware maile, zokit mama wane ŋara soepko sariu!” ’
Ŋo ŋei ŋerep newanonge, eŋe siluŋ don ea desikei wane bauene waki, urataeno urataeno ariwarekoi, mane eŋe bulamakau urataino arike, mane eŋe mere euino arike,
ŋo natne eŋe qelit medep ea malipone more morapŋo dimeongoi, paki enguwi seukwarekoi.
Yale okanbi, ŋei waom eŋe zok sotine osike, paki eŋe kawali ŋeikoune taleongi, eŋe ari ŋeiwa enguwi seukkoi, ea engu wareu paki, matene suaine ea gerepŋo kiwakeu zewareke.
Pakiso, eŋe koso qelit medewekoune edoraki sariu edane rake, ‘Naŋane zokit mama wane ŋara soepne mo mauluke mot waremaile, ŋo siluŋ ŋei ŋereppa newan onile, eŋe ea nekei wane mi onmaike.
Ea wane, iwa yemo numa suaino ariu paki, ŋei ŋerep loutne maratongei, rokop newan onbi zokit mama wane ŋara soep pamaike, iwao sari newarekei.’

Eso qelit medep eŋe mo ea numa suaine pa arike, rokop arikoi paki, ŋei ŋerep korop marat ongoi, rokop ebuwi sarikoi, ŋei ŋerep maine so borikine rokop wekuka, pakiso zokit mama urum suaine ea ŋei ŋerep edo qe watke metkoi.
“Ŋei waom eŋe ari ŋei ŋerep newanongi sarikoi ea onge, paki eŋe ŋei mane kaki zokit mama wane takot laplapŋo mi auki paki sari metke,
paki, ŋei waomŋo kaki paki, qesonka rake, ‘Kima, ge daleo wane zokit mama wane takot laplapŋo mi aunom paki saket iwa metmaine?’ Ŋo ŋei ea eŋe don mane mi rake.
Pakiso, ŋei waomŋo qelit medewekoune edane rake, ‘Ŋine wokomkau, kine so metine weneŋ paki ma birakau, qeinat solaino panaman kotino ketkep, yewao eŋe baŋ aroke, ŋet warik warik ki geake.’”
Pakiso, Yesu eŋe girem don iwa yale raki qoeke, “Ŋine mo detmami, Waom eŋe ŋei ŋerep loutne newanonge, ŋo siluŋ ewekinemdeŋoka sari ma wakon onge.”
Takis Qole Qole Wane Yesu Qesonkakoi
Parisi eŋe arikoi paki, Yesu qeso qesonŋo liwek kaikei wane don ra pisekoi.

Pakiso, eŋe dokoene natne so ŋei waom Herot wane magu ea ŋine ŋei natne taleonbi, Yesu wano ari qesonka more olale rakoi, “Kito ŋebo ŋebon, ŋene detmaine, ge don welekatneka ra okanmaine, ge don wele Anutuŋo ŋei ŋerep eŋane wetineŋo okankake, ea wane ŋei ŋerep kito edan okanmaine, ge ŋei ŋerep eŋane wane zok mi kaetgan okanmaike, me ea wane dere mezet mi okan okanmaine, onoka wane ge ŋei mane ŋetne suaine eŋet biŋek korop me ketkele eŋet biŋek midaine, eŋe rokop wekuka okan onmaine.
Ea wane ge ŋedannom, ge daleo wetkemaine? Ea ŋenze ra rokop don yuanka more, Roma Ŋei Waom Suaine, eŋetine Sisa, takis man okanmaine, me mida?”
Yesu eŋe isi donenane kine dere more rake, “Ŋine isiŋei nau! Ŋine onoka wane donŋo suba more isinanmami?
Ŋine takis mosikei wane wesi ea sikannanbi kawe!” Rakiso, eŋe wesi mane masariu kake.
Paki qesonone rake, “Oŋa oŋa iwa maŋane kaitine so eŋetineŋo okoramaike?”
Eŋe rakoi, “Ŋei Waom Suaine, Sisa wane.” Rau Yesuŋo edange, “Ea maine, ŋine kine kine Sisa wane biŋek, ea eŋe maine Sisa manikei, ŋo Anutu wane biŋek, ea eŋe maine Anutu manikei.”
Eŋe don iwa detpi paki, oŋaene qaeke, pakiso eŋe qeliŋka arikoi.
Seu Seuo Ŋine Wisikae Wie Wie, Ea Wane Kine Qesonkakoi.
Kaiwe weku yewaoka, Sadusi natne Yesu wane sarikoi. Ŋei magu yewa eŋe yale ra okangoi, ŋei seuseune eŋe koso mi wisikae wiekei. Ea wane kine eŋe Yesu liwekau paki, qesonka more iwa yale rakoi,

“Kito ŋebo ŋebon, sogino Moseŋo don mane iwa yale kito edange, ‘Ŋei mane eŋe medewekoune midaine ge more seukeakeo, ŋanomine eŋe yeka geki, ŋoleŋo tatinane malaine ea maki paki, ŋei seukke eŋane ra more medewekopetne qepokki wakonikei.’
Tatiŋon sewen (7) yale iwa gekoi, tatene suaine eŋe ŋerep make paki, medewekoune mane mi qepokki wakonbi, yaup ge more, seukke, eso eŋe malaine ea qeliŋkaki gekimo, ŋone kebaŋineŋo make.

Ŋole kebaŋine eŋe yaleka medewekoune mane mi qepoke more, yaupka geki paki, seukke, ŋole ŋorikine eŋe yalewaka tanik wekuka okange. Tatiŋon sewen (7) eŋe korop ŋerep wekuka maso, seukokan warekoi, ŋo medewekopene mane mi qepokeu wakongoi.
Pakiso ŋado bisoppa eamo ŋereppa ea seukke,
wane baŋ naso suaino, ŋei seu seune wisikae wiekei yewao, ŋerep yewa eŋe maŋane ŋanomine okaniake? Eŋe koropŋo ŋerep weku yewaka makoi.”
Yesuŋo mainge edane rake, “Ŋine don matalimami! Yemo onoka wane ŋine Anutu wane papiao don pamaike, ea mi detlukmami, me Anutu wane zonom ea ŋaŋaekamami, ea wane ŋine don matali ramami.
Ŋei seu seune eŋe wisikae wiekei, naso yewao, eŋe baŋ aŋelo qeliwo gemami yale gekei, paki ŋei so ŋerep eŋe ŋao ŋanom mi okane gekei, i midakaka!
Ŋo ŋei seu seuneŋo wisikae wie gege, don ea wane na qeson ŋunmaile, ŋine Anutuŋo don ŋidange, ea mane mi detlukkakoi me? Eŋe iwa yale rake,

‘Na Abraham wane Anutu, Isak wane Anutu, so Yakop wane Anutu.’ Ea wane kine yemo yale, eŋe ŋei seu seune eŋane Anutu midakaka, eŋe ŋei wisikap gemami, eŋane Anutu. Abraham, Isak so Yakop mo seukoi, eŋane Anutu, ŋo eŋane ra more wisikae wiekei wane okanmami, wetkemaike.”
Ŋei ŋerep magu eŋe don iwa detpi, ewe bibiinerop okangi, oŋaene qaeke.
Ra rokop don Suaine Ea Wane Kine Yesu Qesonkakoi
Parisi eŋe detpi, Yesu wane donŋo Sadusi ŋei eŋane don rara wane aŋaene ma wongeki, eŋe wekuoka sari qeturaŋgoi,
Paki eŋano ŋine mane eŋe ra rokop don kito ebon ebon, oŋo Yesu liwekka more iwa yale qesonka rake,
“Kito ŋebo ŋebon, ra rokop don suaine diawaŋo ra rokop don wane numa natne, eao korop yuanone more, oŋo zok manerop rokop wawaine okane pamaike?”

Yesuŋo iwa yale olale rake, “Yemo iwa yaleŋo ra rokop don suaine okanmaike, ‘Ŋine Anutu wane siminŋuniake, oŋo yemo suaineze, ŋine wet dereret sola so asu oŋa oŋaŋine so mali malipŋine, ea koropka Waomŋine Anutu wet maep okankaikei.’
Yewaŋo ra rokop don suaine so wele okanmaike.
So naba tu ra rokop don mane wele okanmaike, eŋe yalineka, yemo iwa yale, ‘Ge geŋonane ganmaike, kop yalewaka ŋei kimakopŋone eŋane okanganiake’
Mose wane Numa korop, so propet eŋane don yemo, ra rokop don etke iwa eto kine qepotkemamik.”
Yesu Eŋe Mesia Wane Kinane Parisi Qesononge
Parisi eŋe wanok nagu sari wekuoka qeturage metpi, Yesuŋo qeson one rake,
“Ŋine Mesia Anutuŋo birakayake, ea wane daleo wetkemami? Eŋe maŋane qerakine?” Raki eŋe olale rakoi, “Eŋe Dawit wane qerakine.”
Rauso, Yesuŋo qesonone rake, “Pakimo, onoka wane Asuŋo Dawit wetino motki, ‘Waom’ orake? Onoka wane Dawitŋo raki qekoi,

content.text: ‘Magak Waomŋo naŋane Waom Mesia olale rake, “Ge iwa naŋane wonno zonom gorop met magenom, na geŋane ŋabakopŋone kieŋonane bango bira onikale.”
Dawit eŋe Mesia wane ra more, ‘naŋane Waom’ orakeo, yemo ŋine daleo Mesai eŋe Dawit wane ŋaboine, ŋeika rau rap? Ea mi kopkeke!”

content: Raki detpi, ŋei maneŋo eweke more, Yesu wane don turuŋine weku mane mi mainge olatkoi, pakiso kaiwe ea ŋine kieke, ŋei maneŋo Yesu qesonka qesonka eamo ŋado mi okangoi.
